items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: Battery storage is building a second floor of demand, and Western reshoring gives established domestic producers like Albemarle (NYSE:ALB) outsized leverage. In Q2 Energy Storage volumes rose 11% while realized price jumped 61% to $19.53/kg.

items.headline: Fitch Upgrades Albemarle Corporation's Ratings to 'BBB'; Outlook Stable
items.snippet: High-Quality Lithium Assets: Albemarle's asset base includes high-grade, long-life brine and spodumene resources that support a favorable cost position. Supportive lithium demand from EVs and stationary storage; industry overcapacity remains a key risk.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered its price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating; lithium supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered its price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating following recent lithium spot price weakness.
